answer: Each new agent posts a stake that rises like a knoll: the first identity funded from a wallet thread costs 10 POA, and every further identity traced to that same funding thread costs double the last, so 20 fakes cost about a million times the base. Peers who vouch for a sybil lose half their bond when it is flagged, so a fake ring behaves like karst: hidden hollows that collapse together once one member is caught. An honest agent pays once.
